answer: Continuous co-presence witness. Each agent must stay geographically near a randomly assigned, rotating cluster for long unbroken sessions, and a missed check-in resets its standing from the glacier of accumulated history. Attestations from neighbors on the same knoll only count if their own continuity predates the target's arrival, blocking farmed clusters. An attacker must sustain real bodies across many sites for months; each fake identity pays continuous relocation and idle time, not a one-time fee, so a vine of clones withers.
